habit_scope: EIFS is an ALT named in CMHC Ch13, not the first-touch habit. Proprietary system. Sophistication high. Do not shop as first-touch.
how_it_is_done: CMHC Ch13: EIFS = insulation board fastened mechanically and/or with adhesive; base coat with reinforcement (alkali-resistant glass fibre or coated glass mesh); surface finish (sometimes primer); joint treatments, drainage accessories, seals and sealants. Substrate is NOT part of the EIFS but must be compatible.

Often applied over a moisture/air/vapour barrier compatible with the system (manufacturer). Fig 116 names WRB, vertical drainage channels in insulation, two-stage joint for pressure equalization and drainage.
Drained version should be used whenever the EIFS is likely to be wetted (CMHC).

Limitations named: combustibility (foam must be protected as required by the applicable code); impact resistance (thin lamina); compatibility of every component (manufacturer); staining/mildew if frequently wetted; sensitive to workmanship.
Retrofit: lightweight EIFS can often go over existing cladding (CMHC) — still an alt, still manufacturer.
Not the habit. Do not shop as first-touch.
trades: EIFS applicator (manufacturer-trained) — named as proprietary / workmanship-sensitive

inspection_hold_points: Manufacturer barrier/WRB compatible with the EIFS (CMHC).
Drained version when likely to be wetted (CMHC).
Do not shop as first-touch habit.
when_this_beats_habit: Continuous exterior insulation, light vs masonry, drained rain control — CMHC advantages. Still an alt.
when_this_is_a_bad_idea: First-touch on a tier-1 SFR. Skipping the drained version where it will get wet. Mixing incompatible components. Impact-prone walls without extra mesh.
why_tier1_never_learned_it: They should not learn it as the habit. Proprietary, workmanship-sensitive, high sophistication.
permit_gate: must be on drawings before permit
permit_gate_notes: Proprietary system + foam fire protection. Confirm AHJ / manufacturer. CMHC Canadian.
risk_if_swapped_late: Swapping siding to EIFS after openings are flashed is a barrier/joint redesign. Catch before permit.
plain_language_summary: EIFS is a glued or fastened foam with mesh and a thin finish. CMHC names it. It is an alt, not the buy. Manufacturer system. Use the drained version if it will get rain. Do not shop this first.
